The '''Mugaari cargo loading area''' was used by the [[Mugaari pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located in the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]], it was destroyed by the Empire in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Battle of the Tungra sector]].
